test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 03 Dec, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
D, E, F, G, L, M, and N are sitting in a straight line facing north.

Only three people sit between L and N. E sits to the immediate left of N. No one sits to the right of F. Only two people sit between F and E. M sits to the immediate right of D.

How many people sit between G and M?
solution:
**Given:**

Seven people, D, E, F, G, L, M, and N, are sitting in a straight line, facing north.

1) No one sits to the right of F. (F is at the extreme right end)

2) Only two people sit between F and E.

3) E sits to the immediate left of N.

4) Only three people sit between L and N.

5) M sits to the immediate right of D.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d0e7513091150735c766378153dbaa4bf48d8eae558060f6a8ddf82b62fc6c3c.png] 

Thus, two people (E and N) sit between G and M.

Hence, the correct answer is **Option 3.**
